description:
ZUNO is a team of young 
innovators from Kano, Nigeria, 
using NASA open data, AI, and 
technology to solve real-world 
Earth challenges. From Kano to 
orbit, we believe African 
solutions can change the world
summary:
Project Name: ZUNO – AI-Powered Space Exploration and Astronaut Training.
ZUNO is an immersive, web-based 3D educational game that allows children to experience life as astronauts. Players undergo interactive training on Earth, travel to the Moon, explore lunar settlements and complete science-based missions. The platform features ORBI, an AI voice companion, intelligent human characters, crew meetings and multiplayer collaboration. It encourages critical thinking, teamwork, creativity and scientific problem-solving through gameplay. It also integrates NASA's scientific data to create realistic, educational space experiences, with future plans for VR and Mars exploration.
